authorization_participates.why: a redaction changes what the model was permitted to see

cross_language_torture_case.why: every known cross-language divergence in one object: composed and decomposed Unicode, decimal spellings, map insertion order, duplicate handles, multiple projections, denied and omitted entries, null against absent, and version pins out of order

duplicate_handle_normalization.why: two parts of a plan may legitimately cite one artifact

omission_disclosure.why: a view showing a subset without saying so claims completeness

order_variation.why: declaration order is a property of the builder, not the plan

projection_is_part_of_identity.why: the same artifact at two projections is two planned items

reproducible_working_set.why: same handles + same plan + same pins = same view hash

stale_version_pin.why: resolving a pin must return that version or report divergence

unicode_identity.why: an id typed on macOS must hash as one typed on Linux

volatile_fields_excluded.why: observation time and ids describe the run, not the working set
